allow:
Bash(/dev/null <<'EOF'
# Wait for boot, then type hello.elf
EOF)

Bash(/dev/null <<'QEMU'
sendkey t
sendkey e
sendkey s
sendkey t
sendkey dot
sendkey e
sendkey l
sendkey f
sendkey ret
QEMU)

Bash(/tmp/claude-1000/-mnt-data-per-code-mateOS/6cd0eddb-c910-4126-8e84-f85251c1f7f1/scratchpad/test_input.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# Run QEMU, send keys via monitor with delays
SERIAL_LOG="/tmp/claude-1000/-mnt-data-per-code-mateOS/6cd0eddb-c910-4126-8e84-f85251c1f7f1/scratchpad/serial2.log"
rm -f "$SERIAL_LOG"

# Start QEMU in background
qemu-system-i386 \\
  -kernel dmos.bin -initrd initrd.img \\
  -display none \\
  -serial file:"$SERIAL_LOG" \\
  -monitor unix:/tmp/qemu-mon.sock,server,nowait \\
  -no-reboot &
QEMU_PID=$!

# Wait for QEMU to boot
sleep 3

# Send keys via monitor socket
send_key\(\) {
  echo "sendkey $1" | socat - UNIX-CONNECT:/tmp/qemu-mon.sock
  sleep 0.1
}

# Type "test.elf\\n"
for key in t e s t dot e l f ret; do
  send_key "$key"
done

# Wait for test to run
sleep 10

# Kill QEMU
kill $QEMU_PID 2>/dev/null
wait $QEMU_PID 2>/dev/null
EOF)

Bash(QEMU_BASE="-kernel dmos.bin -drive file=boot.img,format=raw,if=ide -no-reboot"
timeout 30s qemu-system-i386 -display none -serial stdio \\
    $QEMU_BASE \\
    -append "autorun=test serial=1" \\
    -device isa-debug-exit,iobase=0xf4,iosize=0x04 \\
    2>&1 | head -120)
Bash(cd /mnt/data/per/code/mateOS && touch userland/test.c && make 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Wrote boot|test\\.elf")
Bash(cd /mnt/data/per/code/mateOS && touch userland/setjmp.s && make 2>&1 | grep -E "error|Wrote boot|setjmp|test\\.elf")

Bash(timeout 90 qemu-system-i386 \\
  -kernel dmos.bin \\
  -drive file=boot.img,format=raw,if=ide \\
  -no-reboot \\
  -display none \\
  -serial stdio \\
  -device isa-debug-exit,iobase=0xf4,iosize=0x04 \\
  2>&1 <<'EOF'
test
EOF)
